metadata.description: Iteration-2 concept-pool artifact (see README.md). One example per data row, grouped by dataset.

notes.openalex_works: input is a JSON array in feature_names order; output = primary_topic subfield_id; full refs/institutions/scores in works/works_part_XX.parquet
notes.concept_work_links: input = [concept_id, work_id, year]; output = match_evidence; concept details in concept_pool_2005_2016
notes.subfield_year_totals: dataset_1 D4 copied unchanged; the 'all_types' variant is the per-10^4 denominator (c-papers include every work type)
notes.nativeness_profiles: exact OpenAlex meta.count and group_by counts, never sample-based; frame = all types; 'unknown' = works without a primary topic
notes.venue_habitat_asjc: habitat_subfield = 4-digit ASJC code (= OpenAlex subfield id where one exists) or 'UNCOVERED'; route preperiod_groupby is NOT citation-independent
